primary_public_system.classification: executable self-improvement/evaluation harness with adaptive VAL selection and a run-local sealed TEST finalize

evidence: core/cap_evolve/cli.py is a real sequencer over phase skill run.py scripts and exposes run/resume/tail/watch/replay surfaces
hill_climb_loop repeatedly evaluates candidates on val and gates acceptance there
finalize evaluates the already-selected best candidate on test after the search loop

post_score_pre_commit_double_look_guard.mechanism: begin_test_attempt checks for any persisted rollouts/test/*.json before a finalize retry; if found it refuses the retry unless CAPEVOLVE_ALLOW_TEST_RESCORE is explicitly enabled
post_score_pre_commit_double_look_guard.importance: This closes the specific seal-on-success blind spot where TEST was already observed but commit_test never ran.
post_score_pre_commit_double_look_guard.test_evidence: core/tests/test_test_seal_rescore_guard.py pins retry-before-scoring allowed, retry-after-any-test-rollout refused, and normal FINAL + FINAL_seed scoring allowed inside one finalize attempt.

crash_recoverability_boundary.provider_accepted_before_first_local_rol: unresolved in audited path; no durable logical evaluation intent is written before adapter execution, so begin_test_attempt has nothing to detect until at least one rollout file exists
crash_recoverability_boundary.partial_test_rollouts_before_crash: fail-closed rather than resumable; the next finalize attempt is refused because any persisted test rollout means the holdout has already been observed
crash_recoverability_boundary.after_final_json_before_commit_test: retry is refused by existing test rollouts, preventing a second look; operator can read persisted artifacts, but the normal finalize path does not source-reconcile and complete the missing commit automatically
crash_recoverability_boundary.design_implication: A stronger terminal OUTER needs pre-dispatch logical attempt reservation plus immutable per-cell outcomes and resume/reconciliation of only missing cells under stable request identity.

reasons: The Claude plugin PreToolUse hook for sealed artifacts matches Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit, not Read or Bash, so it protects against poisoning but is not a filesystem/query non-disclosure boundary.
The test seal is stored per RunDir. A new run creates new run-local state/splits, so the audited mechanism does not establish a global once/cache-only lockbox across repeated research campaigns.
CAPEVOLVE_ALLOW_TEST_RESCORE is an explicit escape hatch, so even within a run the second-look refusal is policy-overridable.
mechanical_terminal_outer.scope_guard: These points show missing structural enforcement; they do not show that a normal optimizer actually reads TEST or that every adapter exposes TEST answers on disk.

statistical_gate.details: The paired mode accepts when mean per-task delta > k * SE(delta), default k=1.0; SE=0 falls back to any positive delta with a warning. Candidates are screened repeatedly on the same VAL surface.
statistical_gate.scope_guard: This is a statement about the audited gate/hill-climb path, not a repository-wide impossibility claim.

contrast_public_system.finding: host/runner.ps1 uses tier6 Invoke-HoldoutScoring as a promotion gate requiring holdout delta >= +0.02 for ordinary candidates; that holdout is therefore a promotion surface, not a fourth terminal OUTER in this path.

minimal_stronger_contract: Persist a content-bound logical outer-evaluation attempt before the first provider/evaluator dispatch.
Bind attempt identity to frozen candidate artifact, evaluator/scorer digest, split/case/trial, and request semantics.
Persist immutable per-cell outcomes and derive aggregate final result from them.
On restart, reconcile provider-accepted/unknown work and execute only cells with no authoritative outcome; never create a second logical attempt for the same outer query.
Make pre-final OUTER access structurally impossible for optimizer/read/shell paths, not merely unwritable.
Make the lockbox authority durable across research runs/generations, not only within one RunDir.
Keep adaptive candidate acceptance on VAL/CERTIFY with anytime-valid evidence and durable candidate-crossing error spending; OUTER remains reporting-only.
exact_next_action: On the next invocation, first resolve fresh control. Then search for a public self-improver/eval service that combines cap-evolve-style post-score consumption detection with a pre-dispatch logical evaluation WAL and cell-level resume/reconciliation, while enforcing OUTER non-readability/non-queryability across runs. In parallel, search cap-evolve issues/PRs for the explicit second-look incident and any planned durable attempt/resume design; if no implementation exists, construct a kill-point matrix for before-dispatch, provider-accepted, first-local-outcome, partial-cells, final.json, and seal-commit boundaries.
